Kit summary

Sparkling FireBasic
Deals 180% ATK DMG to a single enemy and restores HP by 4% of Elsa's Max HP for all allies.
Lantern of RedemptionActive
Deducts Elsa's Max HP by 20%, and restores HP by 15% of Elsa's Max HP for all allies. Meanwhile, increases all allies' Effect RES by 25% for 2 turns. If Elsa consumes any [Fire of Hope] to cast Lantern of Redemption, her HP will not be deducted and all allies' Effect RES boost will be increased to 50% for 2 turns.
Sparkling StarfirePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
For every 24% of Max HP Elsa loses, she gains a layer of [Fire of Hope - Blood], during which lost HP will not be accumulated. After [Fire of Hope - Blood] expires, lost HP will be recalculated. For every 1 layer of [HP Burning] inflicted on an ally, Elsa gains a layer of [Spark of Life]. When [Spark of Life] stacks to 5 layers, all [Spark of Life] will be consumed and self gains a layer of [Fire of Hope - Flame], during which [Spark of Life] will not be obtained. Elsa will prioritize the consumption of [Fire of Hope - Blood] to enhance skill effects.
Holy Lantern Lv.1At the beginning of an ally's turn, if this ally's HP is not higher than 60% and Elsa's HP is not lower than 40%, Elsa deducts self Max HP by 10% and restores this ally's HP by 15% of Elsa's Max HP. However, if this ally's HP is not higher than 60% and Elsa has [Fire of Hope - Blood] at the beginning of the ally's turn, she will not deduct her HP and will only restore this ally's HP by the same amount.
Holy Lantern Lv.2Elsa grants all allies [Consolidation II] for 2 turns at the beginning of each wave whether she is killed or not.
Holy Lantern Lv.3When an ally takes Fatal DMG, Elsa restores HP by 20% of her Max HP for all remaining allies and grants them [Immortal] for 1 turn. CD: 4 turns.
Divine Wings ShelterActive
Deducts Elsa's Max HP by 20%. Meanwhile, grant all allies a layer of [Heal], which restores their HP by 10% of Elsa's Max HP each turn, and a [Shield] by 30% of Elsa's Max HP for 2 turns. The restored HP of [Heal] is based on Elsa's Max HP. If Elsa consumes any [Fire of Hope] to cast Lantern of Redemption, her HP will not be deducted, the [Heal] will last for 3 turns and the [Shield] strength will increase to 40% of Elsa's Max HP.
Source: game files.
